about.tagline: Markdown notes on your own filesystem. The files belong to you, not to the application.
about.title: About Tura Notes
ai.baseUrl.hint.anthropic: Leave empty for the official API.
ai.baseUrl.hint.openai_compatible: For example https://api.openai.com/v1, or http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama. Plain http is only accepted for this computer.
ai.chat.disabled: The AI assistant is off. Turn it on in the settings to use it.
ai.chat.empty: Ask for help with a document. The notes you choose below go with your question, and only those.
ai.chat.maxTokens: The reply reached its length limit and is incomplete.
ai.chat.noProvider: Add a provider in the settings to start.
ai.chat.placeholder: Write your question. Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line.
ai.chat.remoteNote: A note on the server cannot be sent yet.
ai.chat.title: AI assistant
ai.edit.rejected: Ignored a request it could not use ({name})
ai.edit.undoBlocked: It cannot be undone from here any more: the note changed or was closed. Use Ctrl+Z in the note.
ai.edit.why.busy: The note could not be changed right now (a sync is in progress).
ai.edit.why.interrupted: The reply did not finish, so the change was not made.
ai.edit.why.no_selection: Nothing was selected to replace, so the text was not written.
ai.edit.why.not_shared: The note was not shared with the assistant, so it was left alone.
ai.edit.why.open_failed: The note could not be opened.
ai.edit.why.selection_changed: The selection is no longer the text that was sent, so it was not replaced.
ai.edit.why.too_many: Too many changes in one reply.
ai.edit.why.unknown_tool: The assistant asked for something this application does not do.
ai.error.internal: Something went wrong inside the application.
ai.error.invalid_endpoint: That server address is not allowed. {detail}
ai.error.invalid_key: That does not look like an API key.
ai.error.invalid_model: The model name has characters that are not allowed.
ai.error.invalid_name: Give the provider a name of up to 60 characters.
ai.error.invalid_request: That message cannot be sent as it is.
ai.error.keychain_failed: The system keychain refused the request. Unlock it and try again.
ai.error.keychain_unavailable: This system has no keychain, so the key could not be stored.
ai.error.no_key: This provider needs an API key. Save one first.
ai.error.no_provider: There is no provider to ask. Add one in the settings.
ai.error.offline: The provider could not be reached.
ai.error.protocol: The provider answered something this application cannot read.
ai.error.rate_limited: The provider is limiting this key. Try again shortly.
ai.error.too_large: That is more than one message can carry. Shorten it or attach less.
ai.error.too_many_providers: That is the most providers that can be kept.
ai.error.unauthorized: The provider did not accept this key.
ai.error.unreadable_note: A note could not be read: {detail}
ai.key.hint: It is stored in the system keychain and is never shown again. A local server needs none.
ai.keychain.failed: The system keychain refused access. Unlock it and reopen this window.
ai.keychain.unavailable: This system has no keychain, so an API key cannot be stored. A provider that needs no key, such as a local Ollama, still works.
ai.name: Name
ai.sendsOut: While it is on, the text you send to it leaves this computer for the provider you choose. It stays off until you turn it on.
ai.title: AI assistant
attachment.created: Image saved at {path}; insert its link in the intended note.
browser.title: Workspace navigation
caps.notAtomic.body: Saving still checks for outside changes and refuses to overwrite them. What it cannot promise is that a crash in the middle of a save leaves the note whole.
caps.notAtomic.title: This folder cannot replace a file in one step.
conflict.body: Autosave is suspended for this note. Your text is safe in a draft; nothing on disk was overwritten.
conflict.compare.coarse: These versions are too large to line up line by line, so the part that differs is shown as one block. Nothing is hidden.
conflict.compare.kept: Whichever you choose, the other version is kept — the app writes it aside before it does anything.
conflict.compare.removed: The file is no longer on disk.
conflict.compare.title: {name} — yours and the file on disk
conflict.title: {name} changed on disk
device.attach.absent: No pairing exists in that queue folder yet. Reconnect existing queue attaches to one that does — use Create pairing and review to make it.
device.battery: Allow battery use or unknown power status
device.capacity: The server holds {percent}% of what it may keep for this workspace. Nothing is deleted on its own: ask the operator to prune confirmed history before it fills, because at 100% new changes are refused and kept on this device.
device.captureSaved: Publish saved edits to synchronized notes (same path, workspace closed)
device.closeFirst: Close the workspace to review identities or apply received files.
device.collision: Path collision: preserve both notes and choose distinct paths.
device.enabled: Enable scheduled transfer while the app is open
device.explain: Transfer runs while the app is open. Editing stays local; received files are applied only when you choose. Close the workspace before pairing or applying files.
device.list.confirm: Revoke the credential of “{label}”? That device stops syncing until a new credential is issued for it on the server. Nothing is deleted.
device.list.title: Devices on this workspace
device.metered: Allow limited or unknown network conditions
device.mode.upload: Send local folder to empty inbox
device.paired: Paired. The summary above shows the connection state.
device.private: Allow private network addresses for this server
device.probe.address: The server address cannot be used: it must be an https:// address with no path, and a private address also needs the permission below.
device.probe.credentialFile: The credential file was refused before anything was sent: it must be an absolute path to a file only you can read (chmod 600).
device.probe.credentialShape: That file does not contain a credential. Download it again from the server that issued it.
device.probe.mismatch: The credential is for {name}, not for what the field says.
device.probe.refused: The server answered and rejected this credential. It may have been revoked, or belong to another server.
device.probe.review: This credential needs server-side review, which device sync cannot use.
device.probe.unexpected: Something answered and it was not this API — another site on the same name, or an error from the proxy in front of it.
device.probe.unreachable: Nothing answered: the name does not resolve, or the connection or TLS handshake failed.
device.reason.network_limited_or_unknown: Paused: network conditions are limited or unknown.
device.reason.offline: Offline, or waiting for a fresh connection check.
device.reason.power_limited_or_unknown: Paused: battery power or unknown power status.
device.reason.saved_receiver_changes: Saved local changes differ from the received version. Enable saved-edit capture for synchronized notes at the same path, or use explicit conflict resolution.
device.resolved: Resolution staged. Transfer it, then apply the published resolution from history.
device.title: Device sync
dialog.name: Name
draft.found: An unsaved draft of {name} was recovered.
editor.pickANote: Open a note from the sidebar, or create one.
error.already_exists: A file with that name already exists here.
error.drafts_pending: {count} note(s) have unsaved drafts. Open the workspace and keep or discard them first.
error.internal: Something went wrong inside notes. This is a bug.
error.io.busy: The file is busy. Trying again shortly.
error.io.disk_full: There is no space left on the disk. Your text is safe in a draft.
error.io.name_too_long: That name is too long for this filesystem.
error.io.not_found: The file is gone from the disk.
error.io.other: The write failed. Your text is safe in a draft.
error.io.permission_denied: Permission denied writing that file. Your text is safe in a draft.
error.io.read_only_filesystem: That filesystem is read-only. Your text is safe in a draft.
error.lock_timeout: Another process is writing to this workspace.
error.outside_root: That path is outside the workspace.
error.remote.unsent: A note from the server's folder has changes the server did not take, so it stays open. Keep them with “Save a copy to the local folder” in its ⋮ menu, or close its tab and discard them.
error.schema_ahead: This data was written by a newer version. Update Notes.
error.symlink_not_followed: That is a link, and links are not followed.
error.sync.application_blocked: Received notes could not be applied while the workspace is in use. Close it, keep any unsaved changes, and try again.
error.sync.busy: Sync is busy right now. Nothing was lost; try again shortly.
error.sync.conflict: The server has changes that conflict with this device's. Nothing was overwritten; review the conflicts.
error.sync.denied: The server refused this credential. Check the credential and its scope.
error.sync.invalid: The sync settings or the saved sync state are not valid.
error.sync.limit: A sync limit was reached. What is already stored is kept.
error.sync.offline: The server could not be reached. Changes waiting to be sent are kept.
error.sync.own_device: A device cannot revoke its own credential. Revoke it on the server's host, or from another device.
error.sync.protocol: The server's answer was not accepted. Changes waiting to be sent are kept.
error.sync.receiving: Still receiving from the server ({received} revisions so far). The pairing can be reviewed once everything has arrived.
error.sync.storage: The sync state could not be read or saved. Keep its folder as it is for recovery.
error.sync.unsupported_application: This step cannot apply renames or deletions yet. What was received is kept.
error.unavailable: The workspace folder is not reachable.
error.unsupported: This storage does not support that.
explorer.title: Explorer
index.failed: Index unavailable. Literal and regex search still work.
index.partial: {count} entries skipped; results may be incomplete
knowledge.invalidYaml: Invalid or oversized YAML front matter. The note remains editable.
knowledge.noteList: Open a note from the graph
knowledge.partial: The index or displayed graph is partial. Rebuild or narrow the filter.
palette.filesPlaceholder: Type part of a note's name
pdf.body: Review the extracted plain text. The PDF is not copied; saving creates a Markdown note.
pdf.title: Import PDF text
preview.blocked: {count} remote image(s) were not loaded. Blocking them keeps this note from telling anyone it was opened.
preview.blocked.allow: Allow remote images in this workspace
preview.failed: The preview could not be rendered. The note itself is untouched.
preview.remote: {count} remote image(s) loaded from the internet. Their servers can tell this note was opened.
preview.remote.block: Block remote images in this workspace
rail.label: Sidebar panels
readonly.mixed_eol: This file mixes line endings. It is open read-only, because saving would silently rewrite them.
readonly.not_utf8: This file is not valid UTF-8. It is open read-only; nothing will be converted without your say-so.
readonly.workspace: This workspace's state was written by a newer version of notes, so nothing here will be overwritten.
received.busy: Another operation is finishing. Try again in a moment.
received.dirty: Save your edits and resolve drafts or conflicts before applying.
received.pick: Choose the receive queue created by notes-sync-client
received.ready: Receive queue connected. Transfer with the CLI, then apply here.
received.recovery: Editing is paused until the document can be reloaded safely. If the reload keeps failing, restart the app — anything unsaved is kept as a draft.
received.reloaded: Document reloaded. Apply again to resume any pending revisions.
received.restart: Restart the app and keep my text as a draft
received.title: Received revisions
references.dirty: Save or resolve the current note before moving.
references.expired: The workspace changed. Start the move again.
references.explain: Select the files whose links should be updated. Unchecked files are left unchanged. Originals are backed up in app data.
references.failed: Moved, but {count} files changed or could not be written. Review the backup and remaining links.
references.skipped: {count} candidate files have no safe edits. Code, raw HTML and escaped destinations are not rewritten.
references.title: Review links before moving
references.unavailable: The link index is unavailable. Move without updating references? Existing links may need manual repair.
remote.compare.title: “{name}”: yours and the server's
remote.conflict.body: Your edit was not sent, so nothing was overwritten. Choose which version stays.
remote.conflict.title: “{name}” changed on the server
remote.copiedToLocal: Saved in the local folder as {path}.
remote.copyToLocal: Save a copy to the local folder
remote.delete.body: The server moves it to its own trash when it has one. The local folder is not touched.
remote.delete.title: Delete “{name}” from the server?
remote.empty: No notes on the server yet.
remote.error.busy: The server is busy or rate-limiting this credential. Try again in a minute.
remote.error.denied: The server refused this credential, or it does not allow this operation.
remote.error.invalid: The connection settings are not valid, or the server refused that name.
remote.error.limit: The note is over the server's size limit.
remote.error.offline: The server could not be reached. Nothing on it was changed.
remote.error.protocol: The server's answer was not understood. It may be an older version, or something else on that address.
remote.explain: Notes on your server, edited there directly. Nothing is copied to or from the local folder; each note is only compared with the local one at the same path.
remote.gone.body: It was deleted or moved there. Your text is still here.
remote.gone.recreate: Put it back on the server
remote.gone.title: “{name}” is no longer on the server
remote.newPath: Name or path on the server, e.g. ideas/today
remote.notSaved.kept: Your text is kept here until it is saved or discarded.
remote.notSaved.title: “{name}” was not saved to the server
remote.offline: The server cannot be reached. Your edit is kept here and will be sent when it can.
remote.pick: Open a note from the remote folder.
remote.readOnly: The server will not rewrite this note (its encoding or line endings), so it opens read-only.
remote.rename: Rename or move on the server
remote.summary: {total} notes · {absent} only on the server · {differs} different from local
remote.title: Remote folder
remote.unsent.body: Close the tab and lose them? You can save a copy to the local folder first.
remote.unsent.title: “{name}” has changes the server does not have
remote.unsent.window: The server could not take them. Quit anyway and lose them? Cancel, then use “Save a copy to the local folder” to keep them.
search.badPattern: That is not a valid regular expression.
search.partial: Partial index results. Rebuild or wait for indexing to finish.
search.readsDisk: Searches what is saved on disk.
search.title: Search the workspace
search.unsavedWarning: This note has unsaved changes, which have not been searched.
settings.title: Settings
tabs.label: Open notes
toolbar.heading: Heading
toolbar.label: Markdown formatting
tree.actions.hint: {path} — right-click for rename, duplicate, move and delete
tree.create.where: It is created in the workspace root. To create inside a folder, right-click the folder.
tree.delete.permanent: {name} was deleted permanently — this filesystem has no trash.
tree.delete.trashed: {name} was moved to the trash, so it can be put back.
tree.move.prompt: Folder to move it into, relative to the workspace root (empty for the root)
tree.newFolder.prompt: Name — “/” is not allowed; nest by creating inside the folder
tree.newNote.prompt: Name — “.md” is added if you leave it off, and “/” is not allowed here
update.busy: Nothing was installed, and nothing was attempted: the application was still finishing something. Try again in a moment.
update.closeWorkspace: Nothing was installed: your workspace is still open.
update.confirm: The app will close your workspace, download the update, install it and restart.
update.detail.update_busy: Another update check was already running. Try again in a moment.
update.detail.update_unavailable: The downloaded update was no longer held. Check for updates again, then install.
update.detail.update_unsupported: This installation is managed by a package manager, so it does not update itself.
update.detail.update_workspace_open: A workspace was still open when the install was attempted. Close it and try again.
update.error: Nothing was installed. The error is below.
update.error.linux: Nothing was installed. Installing a package needs your password: if no prompt appeared, this session has no way to ask for one.
update.error.macos: Nothing was installed. If nothing asked for your password, the application is running from somewhere it cannot replace itself — quit, move it to Applications, and try again.
update.installing: Downloading and installing… Please keep the app open.
update.relocate: Tura Notes is running from the disk image or a temporary copy macOS made, and cannot update itself from there. Quit, drag it into Applications and open it from there.
update.title: Tura Notes update
update.unsupported: Update this installation through its package manager or download a new installer.
watch.degraded: Changes made by other programs are picked up every few seconds rather than instantly: {reason}
watch.overLimit: {count} folders are not being watched: this system's watch limit is full, so changes in them appear within a few seconds instead of instantly. Raise it with sysctl fs.inotify.max_user_watches.
watch.unreadable: {count} folders could not be read and were skipped
welcome.forget.body: Tura removes what it keeps about this folder: its search index, note identities, session and conflict copies. The folder and its notes are not touched.
welcome.forget.title: Forget {name}?
welcome.removeData.body: Tura removes everything it keeps on this computer (the list of folders, search indexes, note identities, sessions, conflict copies, settings and device-sync settings) and restarts. Your notes, and any folder you chose yourself, are not touched.
welcome.removeData.title: Remove all of Tura's data?
welcome.subtitle: Your folder. Your Markdown files. Nothing else.
welcome.title: Tura Notes
workspace.dirtyBody: {name} has unsaved changes. Closing this workspace saves it first.
workspace.readOnly.identityLost: This workspace is open read-only: the record that ties its notes to their identities is missing, and saving now could lose them. Restore it from a backup, or forget this workspace from the start screen to begin again.
workspace.readOnly.schemaAhead: This workspace is open read-only: its state was written by a newer version of Tura Notes (format {found}). Open it with that version to edit.
remote.adopted: Using Device sync's server and credential.
remote.nameInvalid: Type a note name, not a folder (no trailing /, no . or .. parts).
remote.synced.merged: Your changes were joined with those from another device
remote.newFolder.prompt: Folder name or path, e.g. ideas/2026
remote.folderInvalid: Type a folder name (no empty parts, no . or .. parts).
remote.folder.virtual: {path}: only in this window until a note is created in it
remote.signin.title: Sign in with your site
remote.signin.explain: If your server has a site with a sign-in, you do not need to type an address or find a credential file: sign in there and this device gets its own connection. The key is kept in the system keychain and is never shown.
remote.signin.label: Name for this device
remote.signin.waiting: The browser opened your site. Sign in there and allow this device, then copy the address it ends on (it starts with tura://pair) and paste it here.
remote.signin.paste: Address the browser came back to
remote.signin.done: Signed in as “{label}”. This device is connected.
remote.signin.denied: The site did not allow it: it was declined, or the code had expired or been used. Start again.
remote.signin.invalid: That is not the address this sign-in started. Start again and copy the one the browser ends on.
remote.signin.outNote: Signing out forgets the key on this device. It is revoked on your site, or from the devices list, and until then it still works for anyone who has it.
remote.signin.signedOut: Signed out. This device no longer has the key.
ai.kind.shvia: SHVIA (the AI gateway: pick the infrastructure, then the model)
ai.baseUrl.hint.shvia: Leave empty for https://ai.shvia.org. Only the address, with no path.
ai.key.hint.shvia: A SHVIA key (shvia_usr_…), made in the SHVIA panel under Account → Key. It is stored in the system keychain and is never shown again.
ai.shvia.loadFirst: Save the provider with its key first; then load the list to pick the infrastructure and the model.
ai.shvia.current: Saved model: {model}. Load the list to change it.
ai.shvia.noModel: No model picked yet. Load the list and pick one: the assistant cannot answer without it.
